description: Shiyakusho tetsuzuki: a Japanese city-office procedure companion for elderly users. Six procedures (moving in, moving out, My Number card, national health insurance, seal registration, child allowance) with countable document checklists of 3 to 5 items each, a nod-or-Enter document check that announces when a set is complete, and a manual number-waiting timer with a called-confirmation and persisted completion records.
name: shiyakusho-tetsuzuki
